violated_contract: An output path derived from a truncated identifier must not be assumed unique. Two distinct records whose identifiers share the truncated prefix resolve to the same path, and a plain overwrite write binds the second record to the first one's file: the earlier record is destroyed while the operation still reports every record as written, so the loss is invisible to the caller.
canonical_prevention: Key the output path on the full identifier and resolve collisions before writing: track which record owns each candidate name in the current run and disambiguate a name already owned by a different identifier with a stable digest of that identifier, so distinct records always land in distinct files while re-running the same input stays idempotent.
